title: Mentor-Mind: Risk-Aware, Constraint-Grounded Advice Agents Beyond Chain-of-Thought

contributions.purpose: 用决策论把 LLM 建议接地、避免 CoT 幻觉
contributions.mechanism: Mentor-Mind:以影响图(ID)作推理脚手架,结合 LLM 与决策论规划,硬约束过滤 + 风险敏感目标(CVaR)
contributions.evaluation: 3 合成顾问场景(能源选址/代码审查/职业规划)
contributions.domain: LLM 决策支持 / 决策论规划
contributions.source_quote: We propose Mentor-Mind, an influence-diagram (ID)–grounded advice agent that marries LLM reasoning with decision-theoretic planning.

contributions.purpose: 证明优于纯 prompting 基线
contributions.mechanism: N=162 决策,比 alignment、∆EU、硬约束违规率(HCVR)
contributions.evaluation: Align 97.5% vs CoT 83.3%/SC 78.4%/Memo 82.7%;HCVR 0.0% vs 基线 11.7-13.0%;McNemar p<0.01
contributions.source_quote: Mentor-Mind achieves the highest alignment with the oracle mentor and zero hard-constraint violations while keeping regret effectively at zero.

contributions.purpose: 证明增益不止来自约束过滤
contributions.mechanism: 约束中和/CoT+Repair 平价消融后再比 ∆EU
contributions.source_quote: even if one “fixes” the baseline outputs to satisfy constraints, Mentor-Mind’s integrated planning yields superior decisions.

self_declared_provenance.quote: yielding advice agents that replace the “make-up” CoT reasoning with grounded, trustworthy decision analysis.
Our approach differs in that the “tool” we integrate is a domain-specific decision simulator rather than a general knowledge source.

notes: 循环自证红旗:评估的 oracle/ground-truth 就是 ID 约束下的最优解,即用与 Mentor-Mind 同一套决策论机制定义"标准答案",纯 prompting 基线结构上无法对齐 → 结果偏向自身框架、近乎自证;HCVR=0 亦"by construction"。全为合成场景、无真实数据;头条用"private oracle"(私有效用权重),附录才给 public surrogate。accept。
